source: Course GRADING_CONTRACT.md (common labels, intent precedence, shared severity) + our optional subtopics.

topics.access: Login, signup, password or account access (including hacked/locked accounts, app will not open or install).
topics.usability: Navigation, controls, layout, queue/playlist management, ad interruptions.
topics.playback: Playback failure, crashes, lag, connection failures, audio quality, resource use (battery/data/storage pressure while streaming), devices and casting.
topics.downloads: Downloading, saved music, offline listening, disappearing downloads.
topics.catalog: Missing songs/artists, search/discovery, recommendations, lyrics availability.
topics.billing: Price, charges, subscriptions, paywalls, premium entitlement. Explicitly premium-only controls go here (e.g. 'can't choose a song / only 6 skips unless I pay').
topics.support: Contacting support and the support response.
topics.other: General praise/criticism, unrelated content, or no supported specific topic.

subtopics.access.login: cannot log in, logged out, login loop, password reset
subtopics.access.account_compromised: hacked, stolen, locked or suspended account
subtopics.access.app_wont_open: app will not install, open or start; unavailable on device/region
subtopics.usability.ads: ad frequency, length, loudness or content interrupting listening
subtopics.usability.layout_redesign: home screen, redesigns, layout, look and feel
subtopics.usability.controls_navigation: buttons, gestures, navigation, search UI, settings, shuffle/repeat behaviour not tied to paying
subtopics.usability.library_queue: playlists, library, queue, liked songs management
subtopics.playback.stops_skips: music stops, pauses, skips or repeats on its own
subtopics.playback.crashes_freezes: app crashes, freezes, lags, 'something went wrong' errors
subtopics.playback.connection: no internet / connection errors while online
subtopics.playback.devices: Bluetooth, car, Android Auto, cast/Connect, widgets, lock screen, smartwatch
subtopics.catalog.missing_content: songs/artists/podcasts missing, removed or greyed out
subtopics.catalog.recommendations: recommendations, algorithm, radio, smart shuffle suggestions, repetitive content
subtopics.billing.premium_only_controls: song choice, skips, rewind, order, lyrics etc. explicitly locked behind Premium; free tier restrictions
subtopics.billing.subscription_management: plan not activating, cancel/change plan, family/student/duo plans, trials
subtopics.support.unhelpful: cannot reach support, slow or unhelpful response
subtopics.other.general: general praise, generic criticism, unrelated or unclear text

intents.cancellation: Explicitly leaving, uninstalling, cancelling, switching apps, or threatening to do so.
intents.complaint: Negative experience, including mixed praise and criticism; generic 'bad app'.
intents.request: Desired change or feature without a reported failure.
intents.unclear: Meaningless, unrelated, unreadable text, or a bare boycott slogan without a product complaint or personal departure.

severity.1: No reported problem: praise, neutral/unclear content, or a pure feature request.
severity.2: Dislike, generic criticism, minor annoyance, or a cosmetic issue; no supported functional loss.
severity.3: A degraded or restricted function; some use or workaround remains.
severity.4: A clearly blocked core task, such as inability to log in or play music.
severity.5: Explicit serious financial, privacy, or data harm; an expensive plan, a crash, or angry language alone is insufficient.

rules: Classify the review text only; do not use stars or metadata.
Choose the problem with the highest supported severity; on a tie, the first specific problem mentioned.
For a positive review, choose the first specific praised feature; general praise is other.
Mentioning a paid plan alone does not make the topic billing. A subscription failing to activate does; music crashing for a paying customer is playback.
Cancellation intent does not automatically raise severity.
General 'bad app' is a complaint with severity 2; do not infer a specific defect.
Missing context should set needs_review; do not invent impact.
